query.text: 请帮我照看家里，有安全隐患请及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the house and alert me immediately if there are any safety hazards.

annotation.text_zh: 厨房的锅正在冒烟，请尽快去查看。
annotation.text_en: A pot in the kitchen is smoking, please check on it right away.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
